scope: Authored local offline normal-modes lab and original normal-modes course through unchanged RecallWeave learner

controls.name: Offline launch and identity
controls.expected: Open authored standalone file with network offline in a new owned browser context; rendered course/lab identity, zero application exceptions and no external asset dependency.

controls.name: Pure-mode physical values
controls.expected: At each pure-mode preset, visible frequencies and trajectory at t=0 and a quarter period agree with independently evaluated equal-mass oscillator equations: omega_s=sqrt(k/m), omega_a=sqrt((k+2kc)/m); symmetric x1=x2 and antisymmetric x1=-x2; report actual parameters, signs and tolerances.

controls.name: Keyboard time slider
controls.expected: Focus time range control and send physical Home, End and arrow key events; time and displayed physical state update while focus remains on the same accessible input. No programmatic application-state injection.

controls.name: Pending valid edit versus applied observation
controls.expected: Edit a parameter to a valid different value without Apply. A real observation download retains the last applied parameters and results; UI communicates pending state. Apply explicitly, then the following real export contains the new parameters and independent expected values.

controls.name: Rejected invalid edits
controls.expected: Blank, nonpositive mass and invalid nonfinite/unsupported value cannot become applied state. Validation is visible. A real observation export retains prior applied parameters and physical values. A subsequent valid Apply recovers normally.

controls.name: Actual offline downloads
controls.expected: Keyboard activation produces Browser.downloadProgress completed and real nonempty observation JSON, course JSON, and guide files. Independently parse bytes, compare course to canonical source bytes/semantics and guide to canonical source. Record SHA256, size and suggested filename.

controls.name: Phone-width geometry
controls.expected: 390px viewport has no document horizontal overflow or offscreen key controls, including a rendered physical state and pending/invalid feedback. Capture standalone desktop and narrow screenshots. This is browser viewport receiving, not a physical phone claim.

controls.name: Original learner import
controls.expected: Select the physically downloaded normal-modes course in the unchanged learner file input; preview title, concepts, all prompts, attribution and license; explicit start. Complete every authored item with one deliberate wrong first answer, inspect correct-answer explanation and transfer feedback, then inspect completed review and real notes/trace download.

controls.name: Source custody
controls.expected: Pin tested candidate/parent when supplied and SHA256 every lab/course/learner source input before execution; verify all unchanged after tests. Preserve failure receipts. Only owned profile and transient test server may be cleaned.

boundary: No personal browser sessions or tabs.
No human-learning, live-hosted deployment or physical-touch claim.
Root implements lab and course; independent physics/content peer reviews curriculum.
